The '''Namadii Corridor''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] that allowed for quick transit between [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi]]. It terminated at [[Namadii system/Legends|Namadii]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].
